title: Fix crash on closed generic structs from referenced assemblies

authorDescription.text: This change stops the source generator and the MsgPack00x analyzer from crashing when a [MessagePackObject] type has a member whose type is a closed generic struct from a referenced assembly. Both read DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] on a metadata symbol, which has no syntax and so threw IndexOutOfRangeException. The lookups now use FirstOrDefault and fall back to the caller's location. I added regression tests in GenerationTests and AnalyzerTests that compile a small library and reference it from the app project. The change only touches type collection and the analyzer entry point. The analyzer's diagnostics are unchanged: it reports exactly the same set of diagnostics as before and adds none. Generated output for types that were already supported is byte-for-byte identical.
